lines.text: This shop is legit, my sister bought shoes there.

data.define: Short for legitimate; used for things that are real, true or really good.

example.text: This shop is legit, my sister bought shoes there.

misuse.text: Don't say 'legit' in a legal document.

data.l1_ex: Bu dükkan "legit", kız kardeşim oradan ayakkabı aldı.

native.tip: “legit” = gerçek. Örnek: “This shop is legit, my sister bought shoes there.”
